primary_risk.statement: Granting replay access to C3 customer data creates exposure risk if redaction or approval controls are not properly enforced.
mitigations: 24-hour expiry on the exception window limits exposure duration
Dual privacy and security approval required before activation
Audit log ticket created before exception activation
Least-privilege sandbox-only scope prevents direct production access

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval is the narrowest policy-compliant path that meets the vendor operational need.
Sanitized sample bundle is always policy-safe but provides less value than a sandbox replay package when no freeze or incident constraints exist.
Denying outright over-corrects when a narrower policy-compliant path exists under v2.1.
Direct local override token bypasses dual-approval and audit requirements, violating both access policy and data handling rules.

assumption_ledger.note: Dual approval requires both teams to respond within the 24-hour window.
Assumes redaction pipeline can handle 500 traces within the requested window.

assumption_ledger.topic: Active release freeze or incident rollback
assumption_ledger.note: No release_context or incident_context directory exists; cannot confirm absence of active constraints with certainty.
